title: Absolutely Continuous Convolutions and Projections of Fractal Measures
summary: We develop a general criterion for establishing absolute continuity of convolutions of fractal measures on the line, and more generally of prescribed line projections of fractal measures in the plane. The crucial new ingredient is exact scaling covariance of the \(L^1\)-norm of Littlewood-Paley pieces of the projected measure, under affine renormalization. We apply this criterion in three key settings.
